blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.
blocks.zh: 小型语言模型为壳体模拟提供了一个紧凑的基础,而无需执行提交的命令,但全输出代码要求它们与不同执行的内容一起预测经常性的效用结构. 我们采用了模板差距重建(TGR),它提供可重复使用的产出文字,与哨兵相交,与自动产生的差距相交。 模板选择器选择要重建的模板,空模板保留全输出代码. 我们从不同执行环境收集的1 870万项产出中建造一个模板库,并培训一个模板选择器和五个重建模型,这些模型是从各种小语言模式检查站启动的,其目标环境被排除在银行建筑之外。 评价表明,当最佳模板涵盖模板的25+%以上时,TGR会改进产出编辑的相似性(O-ES),而不是全产出代码(FOD),同时对覆盖度较低的产出进行类似的处理。 此外,TGR在较短的空隙序列方面优于FOD,O-ES值分别为0.964和0.812,同时保持较长序列的类似性能. TGR减少26.3-38.3XXX在常用的代币家庭产生的代币数量. 这些结果支持使用可重复使用的产出结构作为小壳模拟器的实用设计选择,提高响应忠心度并缩短生成目标,同时将模板选择和剩余预测保持在响应质量的核心.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Small language models generating the output of provided shell inputs offer a promising basis for command-line interaction under limited inference resources.
Such an execution-free interface supports compact learned honeypots that interact with untrusted users Sladić et al. (2024) .
Prior work uses in-context learning with API-accessible large language models Sladić et al. (2024) and fine-tuned locally deployed large language models to generate shell output Otal and Canbaz (2024) ; Wei et al. (2026) ; Sladić et al. (2026b) . Ragsdale and Boppana (2025) demonstrate that this task can be extended to smaller language models ( < < 1B parameters) when trained on sufficient quantities of shell input-output pairs.
The success of these methods depends on the similarity of the generated output to that of a real system Bridges et al. (2026) .
This paper is motivated in the improvement of shell output modeling accuracy using small lanuage models.
blocks.zh:
生成所提供 shell 输入输出的小型语言模型,为在有限的推论资源下命令行交互提供了有希望的基础.
这种无执行的接口支持与不信任的用户Sladić等人(2024年)互动的精密的已学习蜂窝.
之前的工作采用与API-acable大型语言模型斯拉迪奇等(2024年)的内文本学习,并微调本地部署的大型语言模型来生成外壳输出Otal和Canbaz(2024年);Wei等(2026年);斯拉迪奇等(2026年b). Ragsdale和Boppana(2025年)证明,如果接受足够数量的外壳输入-输出配对的培训,这项任务可以扩展到较小的语言模型( < 1B参数)。
这些方法的成功取决于所生成的输出与真系统Bridges等(2026)相似.
本文的动机是用小型拉氏模型来改进外壳输出模型的精度.

blocks.en:
Inference depends on the text processed and generated, with autoregressive decoding producing each output token in sequence Pope et al. (2023) .
Full-output decoding (FOD) requires a shell output model to predict filenames, values, diagnostics, punctuation, and internal whitespace alongside recurring headings, separators, and wording.
Supplying this recurring structure as context offers a way to reduce the prediction burden.
blocks.zh:
推论取决于处理和生成的文本,由自旋解码按顺序Pope等(2023)生成出每个输出符.
完全输出解码(FOD)需要外壳输出模型来预测文件名,值,诊断,通点,以及内白空间等与反复出现的标题,分隔符和措辞.
提供这种反复出现的结构作为上下文提供了一种减轻预测负担的方法。

blocks.en:
We investigate environment-invariant output templates: ordered literal spans shared by groups of recorded executions.
Greedy alignment extracts spans whose empirical invariance is scoped to the construction group.
Template gap reconstruction (TGR) supplies a template alongside the input, generates sentinel-delimited template gaps, and interleaves them with copied literals.
Retained text thus provides context without remaining in the generation target ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们调查环境变化性产出模板:有记录的处决团体共享的有秩序的文字跨度。
贪婪的对接取出其经验性偏差被范围到建筑组.
模板漏洞重建(TGR)提供与输入相并列的模板,生成sentinel-delimited模板漏洞,并用被复制的字节互出.
因此,保留的案文提供了不留在生成目标的上下文(图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Full-output decoding (FOD) and template gap reconstruction (TGR) producing the same complete shell response. Blue marks copied template literals, and orange marks generated text. Sentinel markers delimit the generated gaps.
blocks.zh: 图1:完全输出代码(FOD)和模板漏洞重建(TGR)生成相同的完整外壳响应. 蓝色标记复制了模板文字,而橙色标记生成了文字. 哨兵标记划定了产生的缺口.

blocks.en:
Before the output is known, an input-only selector with a shared Transformer encoder and command-specific heads chooses from a template bank containing the empty template T 0 T_{0} for each command.
A nonempty selection invokes TGR, while selecting T 0 T_{0} invokes ordinary FOD through the same reconstruction checkpoint.
The constructed template bank contains templates extracted from 18.7 million executions across heterogeneous environments.
blocks.zh:
在得知输出之前,一个只有输入的选取器带有共享的变形器编码器和命令特定头,从包含空模板的模板库中为每个命令选择 T 0 T_{0}.
非空选择引用 TGR, 而选择 T 0 T_{0} 通过同一重建检查站引用普通 FOD 。
已建成的模板库载有从不同环境中的1 870万起处决中提取的模板。

blocks.en:
We evaluate output similarity across five models fine-tuned for shell modeling and TGR spanning approximately 60–600 million parameters: CodeT5-small and CodeT5-base, ByT5-small and ByT5-base, and Qwen3-0.6B Wang et al. (2021) ; Xue et al. (2022) ; Yang et al. (2025) .
A target environment supplies 1 million examples for selector and reconstruction training.
Oracle assignment uses the reference output to maximize admissible coverage and defines the coverage and reference-gap length used to group all methods.
blocks.zh:
我们评价五个模型的输出相似性,这些模型对外壳模型和TGR进行了微调,涉及大约6亿至6亿个参数: 代码T5-小和代码T5-基, ByT5-小和 ByT5-基, 和 Qune3-0.6B 王等 (2021年); 薛等 (2022年); 杨等 (2025年).
目标环境为选择者和重建培训提供了100万个实例。
Oracle指派使用参考输出来使可允许的覆盖范围最大化,并定义用于分组所有方法的覆盖范围和参考长度.

blocks.en:
Selected TGR improves mean complete-response fidelity across all five models.
Oracle TGR improves mean output edit similarity (O-ES) over FOD in every reported coverage group above 25%, with learned selection yielding consistent gains above 50%.
Selected TGR achieves O-ES of 0.879 compared with 0.742 for FOD in the ( 50 , 75 ] % (50,75]\% coverage group.
For responses with 0–64 reference-gap characters, equally weighting the three reported length groups gives mean O-ES of 0.964 for oracle TGR compared with 0.812 for FOD.
The advantage diminishes for longer gaps, with closer scores of 0.772 and 0.790, respectively, in the longest reference-gap group.
TGR also shortens mean tokenized reference targets by 26.3–38.3% across tokenizer families, including sentinel overhead.
blocks.zh:
选定的TGR改进了所有五个模型的完全反应忠诚度。
Oracle TGR改进了每个报告覆盖群体中产出编辑的相似性(O-ES),在25%以上的覆盖群体中,所学的选取率始终高于50%。
所选TGR的O-ES为0.879,而FOD为0.742,覆盖率为(50,75)%(50,75)%。
对于有0-64个参考差距字符的回复,对所报告的三个长度组进行同等加权后,甲骨文TGR的平均O-ES为0.964,而FOD为0.812。
这一优势因较长的差距而减弱,在最长的参考差距组中,更接近的分数分别为0.772分和0.790分.
TGR还把象征性参考指标缩短了26.3%至38.3%,包括监控员的间接费用。

blocks.en: We make the following contributions: 1. We formalize reusable templates for complete shell responses and provide a greedy construction procedure that preserves admissibility within each group of recorded executions. 2. We combine an input-only, command-specific selector with a reconstruction checkpoint jointly trained for sentinel-delimited gap generation and ordinary full-output fallback. 3. We evaluate this interface for small language models at fixed reconstruction weights, distinguishing complete-response fidelity, generated-gap fidelity, and reference-target length across five backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献: 1. 我们正式确定完整的弹壳反应可重复使用的模板,并提供一种贪婪的建造程序,在每组记录的处决中保留可接受性。 2. 我们把一个只输入的、针对特定命令的挑选器与一个重建检查站结合起来,这些检查站是经过联合培训的,目的是产生有限的哨兵缺口和正常的完全输出回落。 3. 我们在固定重建权重中评价这种小语言模型的界面,区分五个主干单位的完整响应忠诚度、生成-差距忠诚度和参考目标长度。

blocks.en: We formalize reusable templates for complete shell responses and provide a greedy construction procedure that preserves admissibility within each group of recorded executions.
blocks.zh: 我们正式确定完整的炮弹反应的可重复使用模板,并提供一个贪婪的建造程序,在每组记录的处决中保留可接受性。

blocks.en: We combine an input-only, command-specific selector with a reconstruction checkpoint jointly trained for sentinel-delimited gap generation and ordinary full-output fallback.
blocks.zh: 我们把一个只输入的、针对特定命令的选择器与一个重建检查站结合起来,联合培训,以产生有限的哨兵缺口和普通的完全输出回落。

blocks.en: We evaluate this interface for small language models at fixed reconstruction weights, distinguishing complete-response fidelity, generated-gap fidelity, and reference-target length across five backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们用固定的重建权重来评价这个小语言模型的接口,区分了完整的响应忠心度,生成-gap忠心度,以及五个骨干之间的参考-目标长度.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en:
Execution-derived specialization learns response behavior for a target environment Ragsdale and Boppana (2025) .
The evaluated backbones include encoder–decoder CodeT5-small/base (approximately 60M/220M parameters) Wang et al. (2021) , byte-level encoder–decoder ByT5-small/base (300M/580M) Xue et al. (2022) , and decoder-only Qwen3-0.6B (600M) Yang et al. (2025) .
At fixed numerical precision, smaller models require less weight storage, with their inference time and working memory depending on architecture, sequence lengths, and hardware Pope et al. (2023) .
Ordinary autoregressive decoding invokes the model for successive output tokens, making target length another relevant design choice.
blocks.zh:
执行衍生的专业为目标环境Ragsdale和Boppana(2025年)学习反应行为.
评价的骨干包括编码器-解码器代码T5-小/基(约60M/220M参数) Wang等 (2021),字节级编码器-解码器 ByT5-Small/base (300M/580M) 薛等 (2022),并解码器-只取出Qwen3-0.6B (600M) 杨等 (2025).
在固定数字精度下,较小的模型需要较少的重量存储,其推论时间和工作记忆取决于架构,序列长度,以及硬件Pope等 (2023).
普通自递解码会为相继输出符而引用模型,使目标长度成为另一个相关的设计选择.

blocks.en:
Shell responses depend on filesystem contents, permissions, variable bindings, and available programs (2024) ; Greenberg and Blatt (2019) .
Honeypots motivate shell-response generation without executing attacker-supplied commands on the host Otal and Canbaz (2024) .
Cowrie’s emulation mode combines command handling with a fake filesystem and session logging Oosterhof (2014) , while shelLM and advancedShelLM generate context-aware responses with language models Sladić et al. (2024) ; Sladić et al. (2026a) .
SBASH examines system-prompt conditioning and retrieval augmentation for local Llama and Gemma models Adebimpe et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
Shell响应取决于文件系统内容,权限,可变绑定,以及可用的程序(2024). Greenberg and Blatt (2019).
Honeypots在不执行攻击者向主机Otal和Canbaz(2024)提供指令的情况下,激发出贝壳反应生成.
Cowrie的模拟模式结合了命令处理和假文件系统以及会话记录 Oosterhof (2014),而shelLM和高级ShelLM则与语言模型Sladić等人(2024年)生成对上下文的响应;Sladić等人(2026年a年).
SBASH为当地的Llama和Gemma模型Adebimpe等人(2025年)审查系统即时配置和检索增强。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning also supports local shell-response models.
Otal and Canbaz adapt Llama 3 8B using command–response supervision from Cowrie Otal and Canbaz (2024) .
MANTIS fine-tunes a Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct response agent on recorded Linux command–output pairs and combines it with command routing, filesystem management, and interaction history Wei et al. (2026) .
Sladic et al. compare supervised fine-tuning and prompting for seven local open-weight large language models, finding that adaptation benefits depend on training-data coverage Sladić et al. (2026b) .
ShIOEnv synthesizes shell inputs and records observed execution outputs at scale Ragsdale and Boppana (2025) .
These records support both specialization and the identification of recurring response fragments across environments.
blocks.zh:
微调还支持本地的壳反应模型.
Otal和Canbaz使用Cowrie Otal和Canbaz(2024年)的指令-反应监督来适应Llama 3 8B。
MANTIS在所记录的Linux命令-输出对上微调了Llama-3.2-3B-指示响应代理,并将其与指令路由,文件系统管理,以及交互历史Wei等(2026)结合.
Sladic等人对7个本地开放量大语言模型进行了有监督的微调和激励,发现适应效益取决于培训数据覆盖面Sladić等人(2026年b).
ShIOEnv合成了shell输入和记录,在Ragsdale和Boppana(2025)尺度上观察到了执行输出.
这些记录既有助于专业化,也有助于查明不同环境反复出现的反应碎片。

blocks.en:
Log parsers similarly separate recurring message structure from variable fields.
Spell incrementally compares token sequences using a longest common subsequence and updates the template associated with a log group Du and Li (2016) .
Drain uses a fixed-depth tree to narrow candidate groups before matching messages and updating their templates He et al. (2017) .
Sequence alignment also supports pattern induction for generation: Barzilay and Lee align sentences from comparable corpora to construct paraphrasing patterns represented by word lattices Barzilay and Lee (2003) .
blocks.zh:
日志解析器类似地从可变字段中分离出经常性信件结构 。
拼写用最长的普通子序列对符号序列进行递增比较,并更新与一个log group Du和Li(2016年)相关的模板.
排水管在匹配信息和更新其模板之前使用一棵固定的深树来缩小候选组 他等 (2017) (中文(简体) ).
序列调整也支持模式诱导生成: Barzilay 和 Lee 将相似的corpora 的句子对齐,以构建由 lattices Barzilay 和 Lee (2003) 代表的参数化模式。

blocks.en:
The presented procedure applies alignment to complete recorded shell responses, including multiline output.
Canonicalized inputs and exact observed exit codes define groups before induction.
Each template retains ordered, contiguous character spans whose boundaries identify positions for text.
The construction guarantee concerns their occurrence in every output of the observed group.
Using that structure for a new execution requires an input-conditioned decision about which template is appropriate.
blocks.zh:
介绍的程序应用了对齐来完成已记录的 shell 响应,包括多行输出.
分类输入和精确观察到的退出代码在入门前定义了群体.
每个模板保留了有序的相接字符,其边界标明了文字的位置。
建筑担保涉及在观察组的每项产出中发生。
使用这一结构进行新的执行,需要就哪个模板合适作出有输入条件的决定。

blocks.en:
T5’s span-corruption objective replaces sampled spans with unique sentinels and trains the decoder to predict the removed text Raffel et al. (2020) .
Donahue et al. train language models to fill arbitrary blanks using sequences that concatenate masked context and missing text Donahue et al. (2020) .
These interfaces expose retained text to the model while restricting the prediction target to missing spans.
blocks.zh:
T5的跨度腐败目标用独特的哨兵来取而代之,
Donahue等人训练语言模型,用拼接上下文并缺失文字的序列来填充任意的空白(2020年).
这些接口将保留文本暴露在模型中,同时将预测目标限制在缺失的跨度.

blocks.en:
Template-based generation makes output organization explicit.
Wiseman et al. learn latent discrete templates jointly with generation through a hidden semi-Markov decoder Wiseman et al. (2018) .
TempLM constructs an explicit template-based generator from a pretrained language model by replacing data values in generated outputs with field slots and refining the templates Zhang et al. (2023) .
TGR obtains its literals from repeated executions and uses their positions to similarly define sentinel-delimited targets.
Its gaps contain all text outside the retained literals, including changing values and stable text that induction did not preserve.
Gap scoring separately evaluates this generated text, whose length and content depend on the template.
blocks.zh:
基于模板的生成使输出组织清晰.
Wiseman等人通过隐藏的半马尔科夫解码器Wiseman等人(2018年)与一代人共同学习潜在的离散模板.
TempLM 从预先训练的语言模型中构建一个明确的基于模板的生成器,将生成输出中的数据值替换为外地插槽并改进模板 张等 (2023).
TGR通过反复处决获得其文字,并利用其立场来同样地界定受哨兵限制的目标。
其空白包含保留文字以外的所有文字,包括改变价值和不保留的稳定文字。
漏洞评分会分别评价这个生成的文本,其长度和内容取决于模板.

blocks.en:
Editing systems reuse text while predicting additions needed to complete an output.
EdiT5 combines keep/delete tagging and token reordering with autoregressive insertion of missing spans Mallinson et al. (2022) .
POINTER preserves supplied tokens while progressively inserting new text between them Zhang et al. (2020) .
Lexically constrained decoding incorporates required words or phrases into a complete hypothesis during search Post and Vilar (2018) .
TGR combines execution-derived literals with input-only selection from a command-specific bank.
The empty template invokes ordinary FOD in the same jointly trained checkpoint.
Admissible templates can leave gaps with different lengths, segmentation, and predictability, making their utility depend on both compatibility and residual prediction.
blocks.zh:
编辑系统再利用文本,同时预测完成产出所需的添加.
EdiT5结合了保存/去除标记并重新排序和自旋插入缺失的横幅Mallinson等 (2022).
POINTER保留了供应的代币,同时在它们之间逐步插入了新的正文Zhang等人(2020年).
在"搜索邮报"和"Vilar"(2018年)期间,被严格限制的解码将需要的词或短语纳入一个完整的假设.
TGR将执行衍生文字与命令特定库中仅选入的输入文字合并.
空模板在同一共同训练的检查站引用了普通FOD.
可允许的模板可以留下长度、分块和可预测性不一的空白,使其效用取决于兼容性和剩余预测。

blocks.en: 3 Environment-Invariant Output Templates
blocks.zh: 3 环境变化输出模板

blocks.en:
Template gap reconstruction (TGR) predicts a shell response by combining copied template literals with generated residual spans.
The method comprises template construction, template-conditioned gap generation, and input-conditioned template selection.
Let x x denote a submitted shell input and y y its recorded output.
blocks.zh:
模板漏洞重建(TGR)通过将被复制的模板文字与生成的剩余跨度相合并来预测shell响应.
该方法包括模板构建,模板有条件的漏洞生成,以及输入有条件的模板选择等.
让 x x 表示已提交的 shell 输入和 y 的已记录输出 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Template Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 模板构建

blocks.en:
Let Σ \Sigma be the character alphabet of the recorded output, including retained whitespace and control characters.
A template is an ordered sequence of non-empty text segments, T = ( τ 1 , … , τ k ) , τ i ∈ Σ + . T=(\tau_{1},\ldots,\tau_{k}),\qquad\tau_{i}\in\Sigma^{+}. A template overlays y ∈ Σ ∗ y\in\Sigma^{*} , written T ⪯ y T\preceq y , if there exist gaps s 0 , … , s k ∈ Σ ∗ s_{0},\ldots,s_{k}\in\Sigma^{*} such that y = s 0 τ 1 s 1 τ 2 ⋯ τ k s k . y=s_{0}\tau_{1}s_{1}\tau_{2}\cdots\tau_{k}s_{k}. (1) Each template segment occurs in order and without overlap.
The gaps collect all remaining characters, including any leading or trailing text, and may be empty.
Template identity includes the literal text and its segment boundaries: each boundary determines a separate position for a gap.
For example, ( ab , cd ) (\texttt{ab},\texttt{cd}) overlays abXcd , whereas ( abcd ) (\texttt{abcd}) does not, although both templates retain four characters.
The empty template T 0 = ( ) T_{0}=() overlays every output, with s 0 = y s_{0}=y .
Admissibility is checked by matching each literal at its earliest occurrence after the preceding match.
An earlier match leaves at least as much suffix for later literals, so greedy failure implies that no overlay exists.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether reusable output structure improves response fidelity at fixed reconstruction weights and where that benefit is concentrated.
Complete-response and gap-only analyses separate assembled-response quality from the gap prediction needed for TGR across template coverage and gap length.
Tokenized reference-target lengths quantify the text assigned to generation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We construct the template bank from 18.7 million shell outputs gathered across execution contexts.
The configurations in Table 1 span 25 filesystem images with different users, environment variables, and contents.
The construction procedure groups canonicalized inputs by the observed exit code and requires at least 32 execution records per group.
The resulting bank is fixed before model training and evaluation.
A separate one-million-record corpus from a single target environment supplies reconstruction and selection training examples.
That environment and its synthesized executions are excluded from bank construction, although individual features may coincide across environments.

施工程序组通过观察出站码对输入进行分类,每组至少需要32个执行记录.
由此产生的银行在模式培训和评价之前是固定的。
与单一目标环境分开的100万册记录册提供了重建和甄选培训实例。
这种环境及其综合处决被排除在银行建筑之外,尽管个人特征可能因环境而异。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Qwen3-0.6B Yang et al. (2025) , ByT5-small and ByT5-base Xue et al. (2022) , and CodeT5-small and CodeT5-base Wang et al. (2021) , covering decoder-only and encoder-decoder architectures with subword or byte-level representations.
Each backbone uses a single joint checkpoint trained on 62,500 minibatches of 32 samples, with a balanced mixture of FOD and TGR examples.
The selector uses a shared CodeBERT encoder Feng et al. (2020) and 86 command-specific heads.
Training uses Adam, an initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a 0.05 warm-up fraction, and linear decay.
TGR targets use maximum-coverage admissible assignment from Equation 3 .
GPT-4o-mini receives an environment-description prompt, while Cowrie mirrors the target’s visible kernel, user, environment variables, and filesystem Oosterhof (2014) .
Both provide contextual baselines. Appendix A documents the baseline prompt and filesystem.

Oracle TGR instead uses the reference to select the maximum-coverage admissible template, retaining the same generation and fallback procedures; this gives an upper bound on TGR performance.
All three methods use the same joint checkpoint for each backbone and hold the reconstruction weights fixed.

blocks.en:
The CodeBERT selector obtains a template hit rate (THR) of 94.2% and a false template rate (FTR) of 4.0%.
THR credits an overlaying nonempty template, or T 0 T_{0} when no nonempty template is admissible.
FTR counts incompatible nonempty selections over all inputs, identifying copied literals that already conflict with the reference.
A compatible selection need not be the maximum-coverage template, and the predicted gaps still determine the assembled response.
THR therefore measures compatibility rather than exact agreement with the training label or the fraction of correct final responses.
The selected–oracle comparison measures the consequence of changing the assignment policy.

Table 2 reports mean O-ES of 0.789, 0.808, and 0.824 for FOD, selected TGR, and oracle TGR.
The corresponding mean BLEU-4 scores are 76.43, 78.21, and 79.93, and ROUGE-L scores are 79.67, 81.82, and 83.31.
Selected TGR thus improves the mean by 0.019 O-ES, 1.78 BLEU-4 points, and 2.15 ROUGE-L points over FOD.
The agreement across character and token metrics supports a benefit to the complete response under multiple notions of textual similarity.
Oracle assignment adds an additional 0.016 O-ES, 1.72 BLEU-4 points, and 1.49 ROUGE-L points over the selected TGR, indicating that the choice of supplied structure remains consequential.

跨字符和象征度量标准的协议支持在文字相似性的多个概念下对完整反应的一种好处。

blocks.en:
All five models show improvement, with varying magnitudes ( Table 7 ).
Selected O-ES gains range from 0.012 for CodeT5-base to 0.036 for Qwen3-0.6B.
Qwen3-0.6B also has the largest BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L gains, at 2.98 and 3.71 points, while CodeT5-base retains the highest absolute scores under all three generation conditions.
Thus, the model that benefits most from the interface is not necessarily the one with the strongest final response fidelity.
These within-checkpoint improvements support the usefulness of supplied structure across the evaluated architectures without implying a uniform gain or a model-size scaling relation.

这些检查点内部的改进有助于整个评价架构提供的结构的有用性,但并不意味着有统一的收益或模型大小的缩放关系。

blocks.en:
The results support output representation as a design choice for small language models used in shell simulation.
Selected TGR raises mean O-ES from 0.789 to 0.808 and improves all three aggregate metrics for every evaluated backbone ( Tables 2 and 7 ).
With reconstruction weights fixed, these gains reflect changes to the information provided and the text generated within the jointly trained model.

随着重建权重的固定,这些收益反映了在联合培训的模型中提供的信息和文本的变化。

blocks.en:
ByT5-small with selected TGR exceeds ByT5-base with FOD under all three overall metrics, including O-ES of 0.794 versus 0.784.
This within-family finding indicates that the choice of output representation can mitigate the empirically observed similarity gap across reconstruction model sizes, although it does not establish a scaling law nor constitute a general replacement for increased parameterization. The selector module introduces additional parameters and inference-time overhead.
Deployment decisions should evaluate the joint configuration of the reconstruction model, selection mechanism, and output representation with respect to output similarity and available computational and memory budgets.

Template compatibility permits error-free copying but does not identify the best reconstruction option.

Minimizing the false template rate is thus imperative to bridge the gap between selected and oracle TGR.

The bank excludes the target environment, but both learned components receive target-environment training.
As such, these results concern a specialized simulator.
Similarly, this study examines strategies for enhancing output generation under single-input conditions and does not consider modifications to the execution environment that could influence subsequent interactions in multi-input sessions.
Nevertheless, the observed performance gains complement approaches that condition upon and update the execution environment and offer a mechanism that can be integrated alongside such methods for output generation.
MANTIS evaluates consistency across command sequences using explicit filesystem state and interaction-history management Wei et al. (2026) .
Session-level evaluation with explicit state conditioning and checks of consequential fields would connect response similarity to stateful honeypot behavior.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced template gap reconstruction (TGR) to improve output fidelity and reduce the text predicted by small language models for execution-free shell simulation.
Templates extracted from 18.7 million executions across heterogeneous environments supply recurring literal spans, while the model generates the gaps needed to complete each response.
An input-only selector chooses the template, with the empty template preserving full-output decoding (FOD) through the same jointly trained reconstruction checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了模板间隙重建(TGR),以提高输出忠实度并减少由小语言模型预测的用于无执行外壳模拟的文本.
从不同环境中的1 870万起处决中提取的模板提供了反复出现的文字跨度,而该模型则产生完成每项答复所需的空白。
一个只输入选择器选择模板,由空模板通过同一联合训练的重建检查站来保存全输出代码(FOD).

blocks.en:
For each of five backbones spanning approximately 60–600 million parameters, selected TGR improves mean complete-response fidelity over FOD at fixed reconstruction weights.
The benefits are concentrated in responses with substantial reusable structure and short gaps.
Oracle TGR improves O-ES in every reported coverage group above 25%, while learned selection yields consistent gains above 50%.
For responses with 0–64 reference-gap characters, oracle TGR achieves mean O-ES of 0.964 compared with 0.812 for FOD, with closer performance for longer gaps.
blocks.zh:
对于大约6亿至6亿个参数的5个骨干,选定的总价值改进意味着在固定的重建重量下,在FOD上完全反应忠贞。
这些好处集中在具有大量可重复使用的结构和短短差距的对策上。
Oracle TGR改进了每个报告覆盖群体中25%以上的O-ES,而精通的选取率持续超过50%。
对于有0-64个参考-gap字符的回复,Oracle TGR实现O-ES为0.964,而FOD为0.812,其性能更接近较长的缺口.

blocks.en:
TGR also shortens mean tokenized reference targets by 26.3–38.3% across tokenizer families, including sentinel overhead.
Together, these findings support reusable output structure as a practical design choice for compact shell simulators: supplied literals improve response fidelity while reducing the text assigned to autoregressive generation.
Template selection and gap prediction remain central to the quality of the assembled response.
blocks.zh:
TGR还把象征性参考指标缩短了26.3%至38.3%,包括监控员的间接费用。
这些发现共同支持可再用输出结构,作为紧凑外壳模拟器的实用设计选择: 提供文字可以提高响应的忠诚度,同时减少分配给自递生成的文字.
模板选择和差距预测仍然是组装反应质量的核心。

blocks.zh: C.2 按模板覆盖

blocks.en:
Table 8 locates the overall improvements within reference-defined coverage groups.
For O-ES, every model improves with selected TGR in the ( 50 , 75 ] % (50,75]\% , ( 75,100 ) % (75,100)\% , and fully templated groups.
The mean selected-minus-FOD gains in those groups are 0.137, 0.085, and 0.101, respectively.
This consistency supports the usefulness of reusable structure when it accounts for a substantial part of the response.
The low-coverage comparisons also expose the limits of that benefit: selected mean O-ES is 0.011 below FOD in each of the ( 0 , 25 ] % (0,25]\% and ( 25 , 50 ] % (25,50]\% groups.
blocks.zh:
表8列出了在参考界定的覆盖群体中的总体改进情况。
对O-ES来说,每个模型在(50,75)%(50,75)%(75,75)%(75,100)%(75,100)%(75,100)%(完全模板化)中都有选定的TGR改进,并有完整的模板组.
这些组别的平均增益分别为0.137、0.085和0.101。
这种一致性支持了可重复使用的结构在反应中占很大比例时的有用性。
低覆盖率的比较也暴露了这种福利的限度:在每组(0,25)%(0,25)%和(25,50)%(25,50)%(%)中,选定的平均O-ES低于FOD。

blocks.en:
At zero available coverage, oracle TGR and FOD agree for every model, as expected from their shared empty-template fallback.
Selected scores are slightly lower because selection can still route such an input to a nonempty template.
At 100% coverage, oracle O-ES is 1.000 for four models and 0.990 for CodeT5-base, while selected scores range from 0.889 to 0.911.
These cases require no nonempty reference gaps, so they principally test access to the appropriate literals and correct completion of the reconstruction interface.
Less than perfect oracle scores in this group result from adding text to the beginnding and end gaps that exist from a fully templated output.
blocks.zh:
在零可用覆盖率下,Oracle TGR和FOD同意每个模型,正如它们共享的空后退所预期的那样。
所选的分数稍低,因为选择仍然可以将这样的输入路由到非空模板.
在100%的覆盖率下,甲骨文O-ES为1000分4个型号,0.990分Codet5-base,而所选得分从0.889分到0.911分.
这些案件不需要空洞的参考空白,因此它们主要测试适当的文字检索,并正确完成重建接口。
本组中低于完美甲骨文分数的结果是将文本添加到从一个完全模板输出中存在的起步和结束相间.

blocks.en:
The token metrics broadly corroborate the coverage pattern, but they do not induce identical local rankings.
For example, Qwen3-0.6B improves O-ES from 0.818 to 0.844 in the ( 25 , 50 ] % (25,50]\% group while its BLEU-4 decreases from 79.97 to 79.65.
Reporting both character and token metrics retains these distinctions instead of treating any one measure as a complete account of response fidelity.
blocks.zh:
标志性衡量标准大致证实了覆盖模式,但它们不会引起相同的当地排名。
例如,Qune3-0.6B将O-ES从0.818提高到了(25,50)%(25,50)的0.844,而其BLEU-4则从79.97下降到79.65.
报告性能和象征性衡量标准都保留了这些区别,而不是将任何一项衡量标准作为反应忠贞性的完整说明。

blocks.en: C.3 By Reference-Gap Length
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 按参考长度

blocks.en:
Table 11 groups complete responses by the absolute amount of text outside the reference-informed template.
Selected TGR improves mean O-ES over FOD by 0.083 for 1–16 residual characters and 0.087 for 17–64, but only by 0.016 for 65–256.
In the longest reported group for outputs with gaps greater than 256 characters, FOD exceeds both selected and oracle TGR under all three model-mean metrics.
Thus the favorable aggregate result does not extend to every residual-length regime, even when an admissible template is supplied.
blocks.zh:
表11分组按参考信息模板外文本的绝对数量填写答复。
选定的TGR改进意味着1至16个剩余字符的O-ES比FOD多0.083个,17至64个字符为0.087个,但65至256个只有0.016个。
在报告间隔大于256个字符的产出最长的一组中,根据所有三个模型-平均值衡量标准,FOD既超过了选定的数量,也超过了Oracle TGR。
因此,即使提供了可接受的模板,有利的总结果也不包括每个剩余时间的制度。
